releasenotes: Profile fields in the REST API: IPS selected the author's profile field values once for every post, topic and Pages record in a response, again and again for the same member (17.5 queries per page of a topic's posts, 35 per list of Pages records). Each member's values are now read once per request; IPS's own code still decides who sees which field, and values written during the request are read again at once. List of 35 records by 6 authors: 27-28 -> 6 queries. Separate switch in the settings.
